The draft currently has four elements: a logo on the stage backdrop, a ten-minute commercial break, audience email collection for sponsor follow-up, and a host thank-you during the award presentation. I'll need clearance from the contract manager, traffic manager, and data compliance coordinator — each giving area-by-area clearance or flagging required corrections. Once I have that, I can record any action items and make the final approval. Who's ready to walk through their area?
